feature: Plan Tagging Single Aggregate Tag Folds the Rest

original.location: values 'folded driver tag kinds'; TASK-2 action
original.indicated: fold base/, freeze/, lock/ and receipt/ tags; relink tags are base/<stem>/r1-<m>, not a fifth kind

issue.why_free_form: plan_lock._entry_stem names a -commit tag <kind>/<stem>/r1.<k> for every non-history entry, so relink, arm and unlock entries carry relink/, arm/ and unlock/ -commit tags; the planned fold left them behind

new_outcome.indicated: driver_tags covers base, receipt and every EntryKind value; every -commit tag of any kind joins the parents; new node test_archive_folds_the_commit_tags_of_every_entry_kind

why_new_outcome.free_form: one archive tag must hold every driver tag of the plan

original.indicated: reconcile returns ([], []) once the stem has an archive; no commit line for an archived plan

issue.why_free_form: an entry written after the archive (refreeze, relink, arm, unlock) would get no -commit tag, so the D1 re-archive had nothing to fold for it and check stayed silent; a refreeze also re-tagged the base the archive holds

new_outcome.indicated: per-entry gate: skip only entries whose -commit tag an archive folded (fg.archived_names); base_held counts an archive that reaches the base; new node test_an_entry_written_after_the_archive_is_tagged_and_folds_again

why_new_outcome.free_form: keeps D1's fold-again path live and the warn-outside-the-archive rule true

changes.discovered_by: PR 297 adversarial review (I1, I4, M1), decided by the developer

original.indicated: check prints no off-history: line for a base an archive reaches

issue.why_free_form: an archive answers whether an object is tagged, not whether it is on HEAD; after a rebase the archived base left HEAD's history and check gave no relink cue while relink_target still accepted it (review I4)

new_outcome.indicated: off-history: keyed on _on_head alone; untagged: still skips a base an archive reaches; node renamed test_a_rewritten_base_the_archive_reaches_still_cues_relink and asserts the off-history: line

why_new_outcome.free_form: keeps the documented relink cue true after an archive
